notes.title: ChangeLog (2022.11.03)
notes.content:
[h2]Steam Version has been updated.[/h2]
[b]ChangeLog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fetch Mana Verse directly from upstream (so one thing less to maintain)
[*] Fix a crash when trying to validate client files
[*] Fix automatic login
[*] When ManaVerse was launched, show a message instead of a blue screen
[*] Emphasis when you hover or select a world on Mirror Lake (an outline)
[*] Hide the online players name (can be re-enabled with debug tools)
[*] Skip unread text by default (so you can click on the "SKIP" button at the small bottom navigation bar)
[*] Keymap changes: "F10/F12" for screenshot, ">" for skip. "TAB" will try to change the field, but it is clunky.
[*] Fix a bug where the client was infinitely reinstalled on Windows
[*] Splashscreen is now only displayed while it is loading stuff
[/list]

Additionally, Home World and TMWA support was added in an earlier update.

You can find out more details about these features in the [url=https://wiki.themanaworld.org/index.php/Mirror_Lake]Mirror Lake Wiki Page[/url].
